spec: nice!nano v2, genuine (ZMK target nice_nano_v2)
notes: 2 needed + 1 spare. Bridge the BOOST jumper (500 mA charging, fine for cells over 500 mAh): about 6 h for a 3000 mAh cell instead of about 30 h. Clones usually lack it. Measure USB-C height on arrival (sets case depth).

notes: 66 of the 100 owned, with 34 spare.

spec: 1N4148, through-hole DO-35
notes: 34 per half (each encoder's push switch is in the matrix). Cathode toward the row (COL2ROW).

spec: SK6812MINI-E (reverse mount, 3.2×2.8 mm)
india: Not stocked by Indian stores I checked
notes: 33 per-key per half, no underglow (the battery sits under the PCB). The only fiddly SMD part; buy plenty (34 spare), joints fail. Alternative: JLCPCB assembles them.

spec: 10 µF + 100 nF capacitors, 1206 SMD (C1, C2)

spec: EC11 with push switch, 20 mm shaft

india: Robu.in: search "0.96 inch OLED I2C SSD1306"
notes: One per half, soldered straight into the board on its own header pins. Check the pin order printed on the module: GND, VCC, SCL, SDA. Some modules swap GND and VCC.

spec: 3.7 V LiPo pouch with protection circuit (PCM), 2500–3000 mAh, ≤5 mm thick, at most 60 × 88 mm including the protection board (e.g. 505080, 5 × 50 × 80 mm), JST-PH 2.0 2-pin lead about 100 mm long
india: Robu.in / Lamington Road: search "3.7V 2500mAh 505080 lipo" or "3.7V 3000mAh lipo 5mm"
import: Avoid: batteries rarely ship to India from abroad
notes: Lies in a bay sunk into the case floor, under the outer and middle key columns, held with double-sided tape, its lead end towards the battery connector: 2.5 mm below the solder joints under the PCB and at least 15 mm from the controller's antenna end. Up to 5 mm adds no case height. A 505080 holds about 2500 mAh; listings claiming 4000 mAh at this size are overstated. The connector is about 40 mm from the cell's lead end, so a lead of 60 mm or more reaches it. Check the red wire lands on the PCB's + pad before plugging in.

spec: JST-PH 2-pin, side-entry through-hole (S2B-PH-K-S)
notes: Side entry so the battery lead runs flat under the PCB.

spec: AO3401A P-channel MOSFET, SOT-23 (Q101/Q102, Q201/Q202)
notes: Q1 carries the battery current so the 50 mA slide switch only drives its gate (source to the battery, drain to B+). Q2 switches the LEDs' supply from B+.

spec: 1 MΩ resistor, 1206 (R101/R201)
notes: Holds the MOSFET off between switch positions.

spec: AO3400A N-channel MOSFET, SOT-23 (Q103/Q203)
notes: P0.08 drives its gate; it pulls the LED switch's gate low to turn the LEDs on.
R2 holds the LED switch off; R3 holds its N-MOSFET off while the controller boots or sleeps.

spec: USB-C 1-to-2 splitter cable (optional), to charge both halves from one charger
notes: Each half charges through its own USB-C; this just saves a second cable.

spec: MSK12C02 side-actuated SPDT slide switch (SMD, large pads)
notes: Side-actuated so it pokes out of the case edge; the same part most wireless split boards use. Hand-solderable.

spec: 6×6 mm tactile switch, through-hole, 5 mm tall (SW_PUSH_6mm_H5mm)
notes: On the underside next to the controller; press it through a pinhole in the case floor. ZMK can also enter the bootloader from a key.
